plugins.Author: Legends of the Game
plugins.Name: Time Memoria
plugins.Description: Quest progression and pacing — a reflective notebook for your story journey, not a scoreboard.
plugins.Punchline: Remember every step, Warriors of Light.
plugins.Changelog:
Fixed: Quest completion dates
- A character switch could write one character's completed quests into another character's journal. The sweep now waits for the login event and re-checks who is playing after reading the tree, discarding anything gathered across a change.
- An entry for a quest the game reports unfinished is now dropped, so a bad date corrects itself instead of persisting forever.
- The first reading for a new character waits for the completed count to hold steady across two sweeps, so a still-loading quest tree is not mistaken for a character who has done less.
